description: Create a signal type (what a wire carries and the color it draws in), or update one you own (pass signal_id). Comms types draw dashed and let a terminal take several wires without a fan-out. Free users' signal types are always public; Pro ones default to private. Built-in types are read-only.

awg.description: Default wire gauge, AWG: "18", "14", "1/0". null clears it.

dashed.description: Draw dashed (cables / comms). Default: true for comms

mm2.description: Default wire gauge as a cross-section in mm², e.g. 0.75. null clears it. Set either or both.

phases.description: 1 for DC and single-phase (the default), 3 for three-phase (√3 in the drop formula). null clears it (treated as 1).

stripe_color.description: Tracer stripe as hex, or null for none

volts.description: Nominal voltage of this signal, e.g. 24 or 120; the voltage-drop check divides by it. null clears it (no drop check).

name: save_signal_type
title: Create or update a signal type
